snippet.title: Pogo Stick: Ultimate Challenge – Rage Platformer | First Location Walkthrough
snippet.description:
This is the first location of **Pogo Stick: Ultimate Challenge** – a brutal physics-based platformer where one wrong move sends you flying back to the start.

In this video, I take on the very first area of the game.

🔥 Available now on Steam -
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3663980/Pogo_Stick_Ultimate_Challenge/
Don't forget to like, comment, and subscribe if you enjoy watching rage-inducing platformers! More locations and fails coming soon.

#PogoStickUltimateChallenge #IndieGame #Platformer #SteamGame #Gameplay #RageGame
